subject: Biology
overview_en: A cutaway diagram of a plant cell. A rigid outer cell wall encases the cell, surrounding a central liquid area containing a large central vacuole in the middle and a round nucleus to the lower right, alongside various smaller organelles.
overview_id: Diagram irisan sel tumbuhan. Dinding sel yang kaku membungkus sel, mengelilingi sitoplasma dengan vakuola besar di bagian tengah dan inti sel bulat di kanan bawah, bersama organel-organel lainnya.

parts.label: wall
parts.detail_en: The thick outer protective boundary of the plant cell, providing rigid structure and support.
parts.detail_id: Lapisan pelindung luar yang tebal pada sel tumbuhan, memberikan bentuk yang kaku dan perlindungan.

parts.label: vacuole
parts.detail_en: A very large, fluid-filled storage sac occupying the center of the cell.
parts.detail_id: Kantung penyimpan berukuran sangat besar berisi cairan yang menempati bagian tengah sel.

parts.label: nucleus
parts.detail_en: A large round organelle containing genetic material, located to the lower right of the central vacuole.
parts.detail_id: Organel bulat besar penyimpan materi genetik, terletak di kanan bawah vakuola sentral.

parts.label: chloroplast
parts.detail_en: An oval organelle responsible for photosynthesis, located on the upper-left side near the wall.
parts.detail_id: Organel berbentuk lonjong tempat fotosintesis berlangsung, berada di sisi kiri atas dekat dinding sel.

parts.label: mitochondria
parts.detail_en: A small oval power-generating organelle with folded inner membranes, positioned on the lower-left side.
parts.detail_id: Organel lonjong kecil penghasil energi dengan membran dalam berlipat, terletak di sisi kiri bawah.

parts.label: golgi
parts.detail_en: A stack of folded membranes near the bottom center, involved in packaging proteins and lipids.
parts.detail_id: Tumpukan membran berlipat di bagian bawah tengah yang mengemas protein dan lipid.

parts.label: er
parts.detail_en: An intricate folded network directly surrounding and extending outward from the nucleus.
parts.detail_id: Jaringan lipatan membran rumit yang mengelilingi inti sel.
